Ticker ∩ cards = 3 (NOLA 9/5, Dallas 9/18, UNDERBEAR 9/18); ticker-only = 3 (DC 10/3, Boston 10/10, UNDERBEAR 10/16) which have no year, no time and no card. publishedEventCount 6 = the ticker. All three flyers agree with their cards (day-of-week, date, venue, time). pastListingsPresent is true because of the /upcoming-schedule archive and the homepage season poster (11 past dates); the crawled homepage text itself has no past rows.
